title: demo.aadhaar_okyc@v1 send_otp request (EXAMPLE ONLY, not a frozen contract)
description: Example capability for examples/aadhaar-okyc (HUB-351): Aadhaar OTP-based offline e-KYC through a licensed KYC provider. Not part of contracts/: the production capability (kyc.aadhaar_otp@v1, HUB-334) goes through the contract-steward. Two operations: send_otp (step 1, sends an OTP to the mobile number linked to the Aadhaar and opens a vendor session, X-Hub-Session) and verify_otp (step 2, inside that session). The Hub never stores the Aadhaar number: only the provider's reference id is kept in the session.

send_otp.description: Send an OTP to the mobile number linked to the Aadhaar number. Opens a vendor session (X-Hub-Session).

verify_otp.description: Verify the OTP the person typed, inside the session send_otp opened, and return the minimal e-KYC data.

aadhaar_number.description: 12-digit Aadhaar number, digits only. Aadhaar numbers never start with 0 or 1.

consent.description: The person explicitly agreed to Aadhaar e-KYC for the stated purpose. The Hub refuses the call (400) unless it is true; the value is kept in the sealed audit trail.

purpose.description: Purpose shown to the person when consent was taken (kept in the sealed audit trail).

examples.purpose: KYC for a personal loan application
